notes: New: Holiday calendar now links directly to Attendance. Set a standing weekly closure (e.g. every Sunday, or every Friday for schools that close Friday) that applies automatically forever for both student and staff attendance -- that date can no longer be marked at all. Set a date-range holiday (e.g. a 10-day winter break) by picking a start and end date instead of entering one day at a time. For sudden/emergency closures (disaster, national event), add a reason and choose: leave blank, or instantly bulk-mark everyone Present for that date.
